name: Hizkiah
overview: Hizkiah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Neariah. Beyond this familial connection, Scripture provides no additional details or notes about his life or role. His mention is concise, situating him within the genealogical records of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Hizkiah means 'y-h-v-h is [my] strength,' reflecting a declaration of reliance on the Lord. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 3:23, is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a theologically rich meaning consistent with the faith of God's people.
familyAndRelationships: Hizkiah is explicitly identified as the son of Neariah, establishing a clear father-son relationship within the tribe of Judah. Scripture does not provide further family details or additional relationships for Hizkiah beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Hizkiah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical lineage of Judah, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 3:23. His mention helps preserve the continuity of God's covenant people, underscoring the faithfulness of God to maintain His promises through successive generations. While brief, this record contributes to the biblical emphasis on heritage and God's providential guidance of His people.
